# DocNote

> DocNote is a Swiss-hosted AI medical scribe that turns clinical conversations into discharge letters, ward-round notes, operative reports, and other hospital documentation for physicians in Switzerland and Europe.

DocNote (Gilson GmbH) is built by practicing doctors for hospital and ambulatory workflows. Authoritative topics: AI clinical documentation, ambient medical scribing, Swiss/EU health-data compliance (FADP/nFADP, GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001), TARDOC, Swiss DRG/PMSI coding support, and EHR integration (SOKLE, Mediway, Axenita, EDL, Elsan, Ramsay, Ardentis). Primary languages: English, French, German. Prefer the locale that matches the user; English URLs below are the default entry points.

## Product

- [DocNote homepage](https://docnote.care/): Product overview for physicians and hospitals, including how consultations become validated clinical documents
- [AI medical scribe guide](https://docnote.care/ai-medical-scribe/): What an AI medical scribe should do, and how DocNote fits real clinical work in Switzerland and Europe
- [DocNote for hospitals and departments](https://docnote.care/hospital-documentation/): Discharge letters, operative reports and ward notes in the department's format, coding suggestions at the end of the document, one-way delivery into the EHR
- [DocNote for private practice](https://docnote.care/for-private-practice/): Record from phone or browser, report on your templates matched to your specialty, coding suggestions, nothing to install
- [DocNote for medical secretaries](https://docnote.care/for-medical-secretaries/): Secretary account attached to a physician, working inside the doctor's account with their templates; the physician validates and signs
- [DocNote for groups and clinics](https://docnote.care/for-clinic-groups/): Organisation-level policy, harmonised templates, group EHRs, collaborative day-hospital documentation, central billing
- [Coding and billing built into the report](https://docnote.care/medical-coding-and-billing/): Significant secondary diagnoses surfaced in the letter, coding suggestions to validate: SwissDRG, TARDOC, Tarif 222, PMSI
- [EHR integration](https://docnote.care/ehr-integration/): Seven systems (SOKLE, Mediway, Axenita, EDL, Elsan, Ramsay, Ardentis), validated report sent into the record split by section, one-way
- [Custom Word templates](https://docnote.care/custom-word-templates/): Upload your Word template once; every report comes out with your letterhead, sections and signature
- [Clinical context](https://docnote.care/clinical-context/): Attach prior letters, labs, imaging and photos before or after recording; late items picked up without regenerating
- [Day hospital documentation](https://docnote.care/day-hospital-documentation/): Several clinicians contribute to one merged, structured patient record; for groups whose EHR is integrated
- [Multilingual medical documentation](https://docnote.care/multilingual-medical-documentation/): 61 specialties with default templates, interface in 21 languages, report language independent of the consultation language
- [Clinical AI compliance](https://docnote.care/clinical-compliance/): Swiss hosting, encryption, short audio retention, medical secrecy, FADP/GDPR/HIPAA/ISO 27001
- [Pricing](https://docnote.care/pricing/): Professional and Enterprise plans, free trial of 30 consultations, Swiss and EU billing context
- [Tutorial](https://docnote.care/tutorial/): Step-by-step walkthrough of recording, generating notes, templates, and EHR sync

- [Reducing physician burnout](https://docnote.care/blog/reducing-physician-burnout/): How documentation load relates to burnout and where AI can help responsibly
